The '''Battle-upgraded probe droid''' was a product of [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. Capable of hovering and walking, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was fast and had strong [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], protecting it against heavy fire. It was armed with two repeating [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and one blaster cannon for defense against infantry.
